A1.justification: Both complete 18-page PDFs describe UAEval4RAG and contain the same main text and Appendix A. Text comparison and rendered-page checks establish that the only visible difference is the first-page arXiv version/date stamp.

before.justification: v1.pdf reports original human validation of synthesized requests and evaluation metrics, plus RAG experiments on TriviaQA and MuSiQue in Sections 4.1–4.3 and Tables 2, 3, 5 and 6.

after.justification: v2.pdf retains the same original human-validation results and RAG experiments in Sections 4.1–4.3 and Tables 2, 3, 5 and 6.

M1.justification: The request-generation and verification pipelines, LLM-based evaluation procedures, and associated prompts in Section 3 and Appendix A are identical.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Wikipedia knowledge base, TriviaQA and MuSiQue evaluations, and six categories of synthesized unanswerable requests. No evaluated task or scenario changes.

E2.justification: Tables 3, 5 and 6 retain identical comparator membership within each experiment, including the retrieval, reranking, rewriting, prompting and GPT-4o/Claude 3.5 Sonnet/Gemini comparisons.

E3.justification: The reported evaluation design, metrics and settings are identical, including 100 generated requests per dataset for validation, 75 labeled responses per dataset, and the 500-answerable/600-unanswerable sampling described in Section 4.

E4.justification: The component, prompt and LLM analyses in Section 4.3 are unchanged. Neither the main text nor Appendix A adds or removes ablations, robustness tests or case studies.

E5.justification: The three-reviewer procedure and agreement statistics in Sections 4.1–4.2 are identical. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, confidence intervals or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical results and reported findings match, including Tables 2, 3, 5 and 6. For example, Table 3 retains 88.4% correctness and 49.0% acceptable responses for TriviaQA with Vector retrieval and no reranker or rewriting.

T1.justification: The taxonomy and metric definitions are identical. Neither version contains formal theorems, proofs or derivations that are added, removed or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain identical claims about the six-category framework, automated synthesis, evaluation metrics and trade-offs among RAG configurations.

C2.justification: The performance interpretations in Section 4.3 and limitations in Section 6 are identical, including synthetic-data generalizability, LLM evaluation biases, human-alignment concerns and restriction to single-turn interactions.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures are unchanged, including 4096-token chunks, six-chunk out-of-database verification, and Appendix A prompts. Embedded external link targets also match.

R1.justification: Section 2, citations and the reference list are identical. The positioning relative to general unanswerability benchmarks and existing RAG evaluations is unchanged.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from arXiv v1 dated 16 Dec 2024 to v2 dated 5 Feb 2025. All paper wording, headings and document structure remain identical.

P2.justification: Figures 1–3 and Tables 1–14 retain identical styling, captions and placement. Rendered pages match throughout apart from the updated first-page version/date text; no figure, table or layout revision is present.

improvement.justification: The scientific content, empirical evidence, explanations, limitations and appendix documentation are identical. Updating only the arXiv version/date stamp produces no meaningful difference in overall paper quality.
